name: GPT-OSS 120B
short: OpenAI's Aug 2025 Apache-2.0 open MoE (117B/5.1B active, 131K, Harmony format): SWE-bench Verified 62.4%, AIME 2025 92.5%, one 80 GB GPU at $0.15/$0.60.
pricingNote: $0.15/$0.60 per 1M in/out, $0.075 cached (17 providers); Apache 2.0 self-host $0
pricingTiers: Hosted $0.15/M in, $0.60/M out, $0.075/M cached read (OpenRouter, Groq, Together)
Self-host $0 (Apache 2.0; MXFP4, fits one 80 GB GPU)
standout: The strongest fully open reasoning model per dollar, with a published model card of its own numbers.
tradeoff: Terminal-Bench 2.1 26.2% and a 90.8% hallucination rate make it a poor agent, and the mandatory Harmony format is a real integration cost.
